_comment: Golden expectations for demo/slow_orders.sql against the seeded fixture.
Timings are deliberately absent: they depend on the machine, and a golden
file that hard-codes a millisecond count either rots or gets rubber-stamped
until it rots. What is asserted instead is everything that must be true on
any machine: the plan shape, the row counts, which index wins, the verdict,
and the safety guarantees. A run whose speedup collapses on slower hardware
will fail its own threshold and say so, which is the honest outcome.

insight.plan_shape: Limit -> Nested Loop -> Gather Merge -> Sort -> Seq Scan(orders) -> Memoize -> Index Scan(customers)
